title: Puharich found dead at the bottom of the stairs
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Puharich found dead at the bottom of the stairs, about 1995 at Puharich's house, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he he was found at the bottom of the stairs. He fell.

plain: An unnamed guest researcher on the podcast of host Jesse Michels talks about Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode says worked with the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, and tried to contact an alien council. The guest says that around 1995 Puharich was found at the bottom of the stairs in his house, having fallen. It is told as part of the strange story of his last years.
